text: First Spanish class tonight. I could only say my name and order a coffee.
Practised the past tense on the train, still mixing up fui and era.
Had a whole conversation with the teacher in Spanish, slow but with no English.
Skipped the Spanish homework again, the verb tables are piling up.
The Spanish restaurant on the corner closed down last week.
Cycled to work for the first time, thirty minutes and only one wrong turn.
Rain all the way in on the bike, I arrived soaked and laughing.
Got a puncture on the canal path and walked the bike the last mile.
My lower back seized up when I picked up the laundry basket.
First physio session, she gave me three stretches to do twice a day.
My back feels looser after a week of the stretches, and I slept through the night.
The neighbour's back has been bad since he moved the shed on his own.
Looked after my niece Ivy all afternoon, we built a fort out of sofa cushions.
Ivy refused to nap and I was exhausted by six, but she said I'm her favourite.
Took Ivy to the swings, she wanted to go higher every single time.
Viewed two flats today, one had mould in the bathroom and the other was tiny.
The agent stopped answering my emails about the flat near the park.
Signed the lease on the place with the big window, I move in on the first.
First rehearsal with the community choir, apparently I'm an alto.
Couldn't hit the high note in the second song and went quiet for the rest of it.
Choir concert tonight, my hands shook holding the music but we sounded good.
Heard an old choir piece on the radio while washing up.
Lost all three games at chess club, but one of them went to the endgame.
Studied chess openings for an hour, I finally understand why people play the Sicilian.
Won my first game at the club against someone rated higher than me.
Dad found his old chess set in the loft, two pawns are missing.
Took the camera out at sunrise and got a shot of the fog over the river.
Printed my favourite photos from the month and stuck them above the desk.
Spent the evening learning about aperture, and everything I shot came out blurry.
Mira posted photos from her trip, the mountains looked unreal.
Sat for ten minutes of breathing before work, my mind wandered constantly.
Third day in a row of meditating, it's getting easier to sit still.
Missed my morning meditation and felt scattered all day.
My brother Kofi flew in for the weekend, the first time in two years.
Kofi and I stayed up until two talking about when we were kids.
Dropped Kofi at the airport, the flat feels too quiet now.
First volunteer shift at the animal shelter, I mostly cleaned kennels.
Walked three dogs at the shelter today, one of them pulled me into a hedge.
A family adopted the old greyhound I'd been walking every week. I cried in the car.
A stray cat has been sitting on our porch every evening.
Hay fever is back, I sneezed through the whole meeting.
The new antihistamines work but make me sleepy by lunchtime.
Pollen count was low today, the first morning my eyes didn't itch.
Second driving lesson, I stalled four times at the same junction.
Got round a roundabout without the instructor touching the wheel.
Booked my driving test for March and I'm already nervous.
Mum drove us to the station because the trains were cancelled.
